1.o: Prince Arslan from the Kingdom of Pars finds himself into a predicament when a young prisoner from the nation of Lusitania holds him hostage in an attempt to escape.

2.o: Now fourteen years old, Arslan takes part in his first battle against Lusitania, and all odds seem at the Parsian army's favor, until his father, the King Andragoras III, falls victim to treason by Kharlan, one of his generals. (Source: Wikipedia)

3.o: Arslan is rescued by his loyal servant Daryun and they must run away from the Lusitanian forces, led by the General Silvermask, who ambush and capture his father personally.

4.o: Arslan and Daryun seek the help of the retired tactician Narsus, but convincing him to join their cause will not be an easy task.

5.o: While Arslan and Daryun enlist Narsus' help, Lusitania begins their siege in the royal capital of Ecbatana. Shapur is tortured by Bodin as an example for the "pagans" of Pars, but requests to be killed by one of Pars' archers. Listening to his request, he is killed by a mysterious man, who is called by queen Tahamine to be rewarded for his feat. Meanwhile, Lusitania convinces the slaves of Pars to open the city gates for them, promising to make them free men.

6.o: Gieve escapes Ecbatana after having a clash with Silvermask, who makes use of the underground tunnels to strike the palace from within, while the Lusitanian forces, assisted by the slaves, break into the capital and conquer it.

7.o: As the Lusitanian army plunders the capital, Gieve meets the beautiful priestess Farangies, who is in search for Arslan. Upon knowing that Kharlan intends to raid the nearby villages in order to capture them, Arslan and his companions decide to take the fight to the enemy.

8.o: Kharlan continues his pursuit of Arslan, unaware that he fell for Narsus' scheme and his forces are ambushed in an unfavourable terrain, where Arslan's party meets Gieve and Farangis, who join their cause as well. Meanwhile at the capital, Silvermask confronts the captive King Andragoras, revealing his identity and motives.

9.o: Daryun and Narsus infiltrate the capital in search for information, coming across Silvermask in the occasion, while Arslan has another encounter with the runaway prisoner he met years before.

10.t: The Lord and Master of Kashan Fortress
10.o: Arslan and his subjects seek refuge in the Kashan Fortress, governed by Lord Hodir, but it does not take long for the party to realize Hodir's true intentions for sheltering them.

11.o: On their way to the stronghold at Peshawar, Arslan's party is pursued by a force led by Xandes, Kharlan's son who seeks to avenge his father and they are forced to split up.

12.o: Silvermask slaughters a band of thieves and when the leader's daughter is about to be killed as well, Narsus appears to rescue her. Meanwhile, the rest of Arslan's party regroups and fights Xandes' forces, including the mysterious sorcerer that aids him.

13.o: Arslan's small group is reunited at Peshawar and they begin looking at using the army there to take back the rest of Pars.

14.o: With no time to absorb Bahman's shocking revelation, Arslan must decide how to deal with the invading army led by Rajendra, Second Prince of the Kingdom of Sindhura.

15.o: Having formed an alliance with Rajendra, Arslan and company face their first hurdle in their military campaign to win Rajendra the throne of Sindhura. On their way to Sindhura's capital of Uraiyur, they must first get past the Fortress of Gujarat.

16.o: With the fall of the Fortress of Gujarat, Gadevi sets out to meet Arslan and Rajendra on the battlefield. Vastly outnumbered and facing war elephants, Arslan and company must find a way to win.

17.o: Rajendra asks Daryun to be his proxy in the duel before the gods to determine the next heir to the throne of Sindhura. Faced with the fearsome knight in black, Gadevi arrives at a terrifying solution.

18.o: With Rajendra now firmly on the throne of Sindhura, it is time for Arslan to put his affairs in order and prepare to return to Pars to deal with Lusitania.

19.o: Arslan returns to Peshawar. In the meantime, Hermes must walk the fine line between remaining useful to Lusitania and furthering his own interests.

20.t: The True Face of a Knight
20.o: Lords and generals from across Pars rally to Arslan. But now, Arlsan must contend with newcomers jockeying for position and the very real possibility that he will have to fight Hermes for the throne.

21.o: The newcomers continue to make trouble within Arslan's camp and they must find a way to settle these squabbles before they leave on their campaign to take back Pars.

22.o: As Arslan's army approaches the Keep of Saint Emmanuel, both sides make preparations for the crucial battle that will take place there.

23.t: The Battle for the Keep of Saint Emmanuel
23.o: The siege of the Keep of Saint Emmanuel begins in earnest and Parsian generals, who once fought on the same side, now find themselves facing each other across the battlefield.

24.o: Étoile wrestles with the knowledge that the prince, whose head he had wanted for so long, was someone he knew. And the battle for the Keep of Saint Emmanuel continues.

25.t: The Highway of Blood and Sweat
25.o: Arslan's army deals with the aftermath of the battle for the Keep of Saint Emmanuel.

1.o: The Kingdom of Turan decides to take advantage of Pars's moment of weakness to invade, forcing Arslan to abandon his plan to retake Ecbatana in order to secure the border at Peshawar.

2.o: The Turanians regroup and prepare to make another attempt to take Peshawar Fortress, this time, using more underhanded means. Meanwhile, Andragoras makes good his escape from Ecbatana and the Lusitanians.

3.o: As Hilmes continues to pursue the treasured sword Rukhnabad, he comes across someone from his past. In the meantime, in Peshawar, King Andragoras sets Arslan a task that is seemingly cruel and impossible.

4.t: A City of Land and a City of Water
4.o: Arslan and his party head for the port city of Gilan to the south and get a lay of the land as they begin their attempt to assemble an army of 50 thousand men as King Andragoras ordered.

5.o: Arslan continues his quest to raise an army of 50 thousand, as well as the capital required to fund such an army. His immediate obstacle is the suspiciously obsequious Viceroy of Gilan, Pelagius.

6.o: Back in Ecbatana, Guiscard is sorely regretting leaving Andragoras alive long enough to escape and is determined that he will not make the same mistake again.

7.o: The bulk of Arslan's people set out for an uninhabited island in search of hidden treasure, but back in Gilan, there is still the unresolved matter of the mastermind behind the pirates.

8.o: With the arrival of Étoile and Merlane, Arslan learns of the situation in Ecbatana. And while he is still far short of amassing an army of 50 thousand, he must decide whether to act upon this information or not.

Will she be able to talk Emerl into ceasing his uncontrollable mayhem, or will she have no choice but to fight and shut him down?

26.o: Sonic must save Tails from a tailspin.

1.o: The newly graduated seniors await the kickoff signal from this year's judges, and tensions build as old friends become new competitors. Heather has sworn she will never play the game, but she may not have a choice.

2.o: Twenty-three players are in, and the stakes are high--literally. Panic's second challenge takes the players sky-high, even as the game attracts the attention of the sheriff and his deputies who are dead set on stopping it. The new kid's odds are looking up until a bit of surprise sabotage.

3.o: The town celebrates the fourth of July with a parade, but one float carries an old ghost, and coded instructions that call the players to a third challenge. A nighttime raid on a dangerous property and some surprise alliances mean Heather will have to seriously watch her step.

4.o: Narrow escapes take on literal meaning as a disastrous series of events at the third challenge puts all the players' lives in danger. Luckily, the players get a short break at the annual Player's Ball, where sparks fly unexpectedly between competitors, and old trouble returns to cause new problems.

5.o: The players brave a night at the local haunted house, where ghosts new and old make themselves known. The answer to a riddle reveals the game's troubled legacy, Heather's goals almost go up in smoke, and we learn that one of Panic's loudest detractors has a secret connection to the game.

6.o: The annual demolition derby provides some much-needed distraction from the troubling revelations of the previous episode. With the cops closing in on the judges, no one is sure the game can continue. Heather repairs one relationship, and ruptures another, in a dramatic ending that proves the game must go on...but not for everyone.

7.o: Trust falls get literal meaning in the game's fifth challenge, where an abandoned train bridge forms the backdrop for revealing footage of our players-and the unintentional outcome of their secrets, and their lies. This challenge will determine who goes onto Final Four. The truth may set our players free...but not before it returns to haunt them.

8.o: The judges get personal when they announce the first of the four individual challenges that will establish the game's finalists. Past and present collide in the unexpected exposure of our player's motivations--and enmities. The sheriff gets closer to making an arrest, and Heather has her heart broken.

9.o: One of our Final Four players is disqualified, opening the door for a surprise upset, and a dramatic showdown. As outside pressure on the game escalates, the consequences are wild...literally. Our players learn the hard way what's really at risk when you gamble it all on a game.

10.o: Someone is dead set on making sure that Joust, the final challenge, ends with the right winner-and Heather realizes that for at least one person, Panic isn't a game anymore. An explosive conclusion brings the game to a permanent end...or so, at least, it seems. This year's players may be finished with the game. But it may not be finished with them.

1.o: It is 1840, year 1 of Japan's Tenpo era. There lies a small village known as Kadono that is home to the siblings Jinta and Suzune. Jinta is quickly dispatched to slay demons.

4.o: Jinya and Natsu get attacked by the slasher thought to be a demon. After Mosuke arrives to help and Jinya brandishes his blade, the demon quickly vanishes into the darkness.

6.o: Jinya and Naotsugu witness a young girl losing her parents in a fire, which brings the unexpected truth of the mystery to light.

7.o: In the winter of 1853, Jinya is hired by Jyuuzou to investigate a demonic painting known as "the Ukiyo-e of Kudanzaka" that's said to be cursed.

8.o: In the spring of 1854, rumors spread of a demon woman who kills men in the Yoshiwara redlight district. Jinya investigates.

9.o: A man named Somegorou Akitsu gifts Natsu a hairpin then crosses paths with Jinya. Somegorou's spirit dogs attack Jinya and he must use his demon powers to defend himself.

10.o: In May of 1855, Naotsugu and a woman in a kimono catch sight of a man in the distance who looks different to both. Naotsugu sees his brother and the woman sees an old flame.

11.o: In winter of 1856, Zenji brings a liquor to the soba shop and it becomes immensely popular. However, Jinya finds something unsavory about it.

12.o: A series of violent incidents occur across Edo, all related to Yuki-no-Nagori. Worse yet, rumors of a woman with blonde hair send chills down Jinya's spine.

13.o: It turns out Yuki-no-Nagori is an evil drink. Jinya finds a demon calling out the name "Jinta". As they face off, Jinya suffers from the weakness of his own heart.

14.o: Back in the winter of 1839, when Jinya was still just Jinta, there were rumors of strange phenomena occurring near the Modori River. Byakuya orders Jinta to investigate.

15.t: Late Night Tales of Demonic Swords ~Hijin~
15.o: The year is 1862. The arrival of the Perry Expedition in Japan brings unrest into the cities. Jinya hears about a cursed sword called the "Yatonomori Kaneomi."

16.o: In July of 1863, Jinya hears rumors of a demon in Mizuho temple that devours humans. Upon visiting, Jinya comes across a silver-haired fox demon.

17.o: In March of 1864, a job comes to Jinya to slay a demon named Okada. Okada has become a crazed murderer willing to kill anyone from fellow samurai to women and children.

18.o: In September of 1867, Somegoro Akitsu leaves Kyoto with a tea set that he takes to Jinya. Akitsu wants to find someone who can use the set to conduct a tea ceremony.

19.o: Jinya and his daughter, Nomari, enjoy peaceful days staying with Naotsugu and his family. However, time changes all things and their world faces a drastic transformation.

20.o: While engaged in a fierce battle with Tsuchiura, Jinya is forced to take on his demonic form, witnessed by both Naotsugu and Nomari.

21.o: Jinya and Tsuchiura face off during a heavy rainstorm. When Jinya's demon arm begins to throb, it sparks a resonance that allows them to experience each other's pasts.

22.o: In April of 1872, Jinya departs Edo and now lives in Kyoto. He runs a soba shop on Sanjyo Street. One night, Jinya saves a girl named Himawari as she's surrounded by demons.

23.t: A Tale of Candy Apples and the Heavenly Maiden (Part 1)
23.o: Akitsu tells Jinya about the legend of a goddess associated with the Aragi Inari Shrine. Jinya pays a visit to the shrine, only to find a woman saying: "we finally meet."

24.t: A Tale of Candy Apples and the Celestial Maiden (Part 2)
24.o: Jinya and Asagao visit the head priest of the Aragi Inari Shrine, who explains how return to the time and place of Asagao's choosing. However, she hesitates to go back or not.

1.o: في المهمة الجديدة، وبعد أن اكتشف "آليّ الأمن" الإرادة الحرة حديثاً، يولّد سلوكه الغريب شكوكاً لدى فريق "الصيانة المساعدة".

2.o: تخاطر "مينساه" و"بارادواج" بكلّ شيء في سبيل التحقيق في منطقة غامضة. يتواجه "غوراثين" مع "موردربوت".

3.o: يتجه فريق "الصيانة المساعدة" إلى قاعدة جديدة بحثاً عن إجابات. يتورط "موردربوت" في مواجهة مسلحة مع "آليّ أمن".

4.o: فيما يستهدف عدو "موردربوت"، يحاول حليف تنظيم عملية هروب. ينازع الفريق بعد اهتزاز قيادته وفي ظل مهلة نهائية صادمة.

5.o: يتخطى فريق "الصيانة المساعدة" كلّ العقبات لشقّ طريقه إلى الأمام. يتصاعد التوتر والضغط في ظل امتحان للثقة، فيما ينضم ناج من فريق "ديلتفول" إلى المجموعة.

6.o: تطرأ مشكلة خطيرة تهزّ الفريق وتضعضعه. تخاطر "مينساه" في عملية صعبة ودقيقة. تغيّر "ليبيبي" أسلوبها.

7.o: يتعامل "موردربوت" مع النتائج ويرصد تهديداً خطيراً. يتجه الفريق نحو منطقة محلية مليئة بالمفاجآت، على أمل تجنّب الخطر.

8.o: يتلقى فريق "الصيانة المساعدة" طرداً من مجموعة منافسة. يتعمق "غوراثين" في ماضي "موردربوت" الدامي.

9.o: يتخذ "موردربوت" القرارات في لقاء حساس ودقيق. يضع "غوراثين" و"بين لي" خطة. تقوم "مينساه" بخطوة من تلقاء نفسها.

10.o: يقبع مصير "موردربوت" في كفة ميزان. في المصفوفة المؤسساتية، يقدّم فريق "الصيانة المساعدة" طلباً متهوراً.

1.o: A wild weekend getaway to Båstad ends in a rude awakening for Lollo, Mia, Klara and Frida when a pair of shocking letters arrives in the mail.

2.o: A vulnerable but vengeful Lollo appoints a strategic ally to carry out her retaliation while Klara figures out how to handle her fall from grace.

3.o: The perfect alibi presents itself as the friends and their parents attend lavish parties. Frida's wish to fit in results in a traumatizing encounter.

4.o: Reeling from the impact of Lollo's drunken antics, the group goes on a cabin trip to relax and clear the air between them, but old habits die hard.

5.o: Klara's facade starts to crumble as her guilt and shame cause her to break down. After she's discovered, Mia's desperate ploy borrows her some time.

6.o: The group mounts a frantic extortion bid to avoid culpability in the burglaries. Has their luck finally run out?

1.t: I Can't Live in That Mad House
1.o: Lollo returns from studying in Paris to find her crew broke and bored. They promised no more heists, but a chance for easy money proves too tempting.

2.t: We'll Never Be Able to Afford the Apartment
2.o: As the loose ends keep piling up, Lollo comes up with a new plan to sell their spoils, which unfortunately involves lying to Klara and Frida.

3.t: I'm So Tired of Being Poor
3.o: Having blown all their money on the deposit for their new flat, the crew decides to organize one last heist — until someone else beats them to it.

4.o: The turmoil of all their schemes starts sowing distrust among the crew. Lollo grows closer to Jesper while Klara is surprised by a marriage proposal.

5.o: Klara, Frida and Mia are unable to reach the others, forcing them to manage the exchange of the painting on their own — with disastrous results.

6.t: You Know That Hair in Jesper's Car
6.o: The crew is a hair's breadth from getting away with everything, but that hair becomes troublesome for Lollo.

1.o: Aylín discovers supernatural abilities on the same day her teacher Emma disappears. While dealing with school and family conflicts, Aylín begins to have disturbing visions when she eats dirt. Along with her brother Walter and her new friend Vero, she investigates Emma's whereabouts. A terrifying revelation and an unexpected arrest will make the search even more complicated.

2.o: Aylín desperately searches for Emma. With the help of Ezequiel, a skeptical police officer, she follows clues that lead to dangerous revelations. Meanwhile, the school prepares to demand the return of the teacher. The search culminates in a devastating confrontation that will change everything.

3.o: Aylín is recruited by Ezequiel to find a missing boy. While her visions escalate, Aylín strengthens her friendship with Vero and encounters dangers during the search. During a neighborhood fair, a startling confrontation forces Aylín to question the impact her powers have on both her safety and the well-being of her friends.

4.o: Aylín reunites with her father, Raúl, who tries to rebuild their family relationship. His reappearance creates tension between Aylín and Walter. Meanwhile, Aylín and Ezequiel search for a girl who is trapped after a disturbing vision.

5.o: Aylín helps her father Raul find an old friend, in the process she discovers that she is not the only one in the family with a special gift. Walter, with the help of a new ally, tries to uncover Raul's true intentions. After enduring a violent humiliation at school, Aylín considers giving up her power, facing an internal struggle about her identity and her family legacy.

6.o: Aylín is forced to find Karina without her power, which causes tensions with her group of friends. Walter confronts his father and faces the consequences of wanting to protect Aylín. Calaca, torn between his family and his friends, must embrace the legacy he inherits from his father, El Nahual.

7.o: Aylín, worried about her brother Walter’s disappearance, decides to recover her lost power, but not everything that is rejected can be recovered. Along with her friends and Miseria, she embarks on a dangerous journey that puts their lives at risk and challenges their bond. In the end, Aylín unburies the truth about her legacy and prepares to embrace her destiny.

1.o: When his teacher confiscates his motorcycle, unruly Lu Xixiao must learn from top student Zhou Wan and rank among the 1,000 best pupils to get it back.

2.o: As her grandmother's medical bills mount, Wan faces pressure from a petty criminal over her father's debts and offers to tutor Xixiao for extra cash.

3.o: As they grow closer, Wan and Xixiao embark on a mission to give a group of unwanted goldfish a better home.

4.o: Guo Xiangling confronts Wan and offers to cover her grandmother's medical bills if she cuts ties with Xixiao.

5.o: Wan's grandmother collapses on the day of the college entrance exam while Xixiao gets some unwanted news about his mother's house.

6.o: Wan discovers the truth about her father's life insurance policy while Xixiao strikes a bargain to protect his mother's home.

7.o: At the Lu family banquet, Wan seeks Xiangling's help to save her grandmother, while Xixiao clashes with his family over his dream of studying art abroad.

8.o: After moving into the Lu family home, Wan nurses a sick Xixiao and helps him break through his creative block by organizing a children's puppet show.

9.o: Wan and Xixiao spend a carefree day at an amusement park and help Jiang Fan express his feelings for Gu Meng.

10.o: Wan struggles to raise money for her grandmother's surgery and turns to her landlord for help, while Xixiao challenges Luo He to a basketball showdown.

11.o: After Wan suffers an injury, Xixiao finally learns the extent of her financial struggles and uncovers the truth about her grandmother's medical bills.

12.o: After Wan races to find Xixiao before he leaves the country, the pair reunite and join forces for an unexpected rooftop rescue.

13.o: Just as Xixiao asks Wan to take their relationship to the next level, a sudden tragedy strikes, threatening their newfound happiness.

14.o: After saying goodbye at a crowded funeral hall, Wan returns home in the throes of grief and narrowly avoids a tragic accident.

15.o: Xixiao fulfills Wan's wish by winning her a bicycle at an arcade, deeply moving her, while Luo He, feeling betrayed, targets her in retaliation.

16.o: Family secrets erupt at Xiangling's wedding as Wan and Xixiao fight to stay together despite growing pressure to keep them apart.

17.o: After pulling off a clever escape, Wan and Xixiao flee north to see the snow, but mounting financial troubles threaten their dream of a fresh start.

18.o: Wan and Xixiao briefly return to Pingchuan before crafting another escape, while Xixiao's father demands his loyalty over the shareholding dispute.

19.o: When Luo He kidnaps Wan, Xixiao rescues her in a violent scuffle, leaving him badly injured. In the hospital, his grandfather forces Wan to leave.

20.o: At the hospital, Wan listens to Xixiao talk about his life plans and shocks him by initiating a painful conversation about their relationship.

21.o: After Wan starts working for the Lanyue Group, she revisits Yangming High School and has an emotional encounter with Xixiao.

22.o: Wan and Xixiao share tender moments before they face off in the Lanyue resort bidding war, where each reveals secrets that force the other to fight back.

23.o: After winning the bid, Xixiao works through his feelings, while Wan uses the evidence she has against Zhongyue to join Dingshang.

24.o: Forced to live together, Wan and Xixiao navigate the simmering tension between them, while Xixiao's jealousy continues to grow.

25.o: While working on the Lanyue project, Wan faces harassment from the boss of a partner company, and Xixiao steps in to expose him.

26.o: Jiang Fan's birthday party stirs old memories for Wan, leading her and Xixiao to admit their feelings for each other.

27.o: As their romance deepens, Wan and Xixiao use business negotiations as an excuse to date, and Wan reveals some upsetting secrets about her past.

28.o: Xixiao and Yan rush to the rescue after factory manager Wang abducts Wan, and new evidence exposes Zhongyue's long-hidden wrongdoings.

29.o: After Wan and Xixiao cement their relationship, they reminisce about their earliest memories of each other and the 10 years they spent apart.

1.o: ‫بعد حادثة إطلاق نار مميتة، ينطلق الفانوس الأخضر هال جوردان والمجند الجديد جون ستيوارت ليثبتا بأن الحادثة كانت نتيجة لحدث من خارج الأرض.

2.o: ‫في حين أن مهمة جون العادية تنتهي بمفاجآت، يثير هال ضجة في راشفيل - مما يدفعه للتعمق أكثر.

3.o: ‫عندما يسيء والده فهم محاولة اتصال من الحراس، يتم ترشيح جون باعتباره الخيار الأفضل التالي لتحقيق مصير غرين لانترن. وبعد ذلك، يحصل جون أخيرًا على فرصته لإجراء مقابلة مع الحراس، بعد فترة طويلة من الاستعداد.

4.o: ‫مع اقتراب انتهاء مهلة الـ 48 ساعة، يطور جون نظرية جديدة حول موقع مانهنتر، مما يدفعه هو وهال إلى عرض خطوتهم التالية على الشريف كين. و في غضون ذلك، تنجم عواقب عن زيارة هال إلى سينسترو.

5.o: ‫مع انكشاف تاريخ عائلة ماكون، تتحرك مدينة راشفيل لمواجهة التهديد المتصاعد. ويجد جون نفسه في موقف صعب، بينما يخاطر هال بكل شيء في محاولة أخيرة للقضاء على مانهانتر.

6.o: ‫يعمل جون الآن مع شقيقه ماركوس، وهو على وشك الحصول على مستثمر كبير لمشروعه المبتكر في مجال غرف الأمان عندما تجذبه مكالمة هاتفية غير متوقعة إلى العودة إلى راشفيل وإلى كل ما بذل جهدًا كبيرًا لتركه وراءه.

7.o: ‫خلال تواجد هال وجون على كوكب آخر، يتوجب عليهما تجاوز خلافاتهما السابقة لحل جريمة قتل. وخلال رحلتهما، يُجبران على مواجهة الماضي.. وكيف شكلت طفولتهما شخصيتيهما الحالية.

8.o: ‫مع اقتراب جون وهال من الحقيقة، يتوصل جون إلى تفاهم غير متوقع مع الشريف كين... في الوقت الذي يظهر فيه اكتشاف جديد ومثير للرعب.
